name: Find Love 2: Rhapsody
source:
Main is a high school student who aspires to become a professional musician. One day he is asked by his father to substitute him as apartment manager for the summer. The building appears to be inhabited only by school girls. This summer promises to be hot. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-october-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名立志成为专业音乐家的高中生。某天，父亲请他在暑假代替自己担任公寓管理员。那栋楼里似乎只住着女学生。这个夏天注定火热。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-october-1998.html]VNDB Review[/url]]
